claims.text: The strategy fades the London open on EURUSD.
claims.quote: the London open fade on EURUSD

claims.text: Mark the Asian session range on the 15-minute chart.
claims.quote: Mark the Asian session high and low on the 15 minute chart

claims.text: Sell at the next open after price breaks the Asian high in the first London hour and closes back inside.
claims.quote: When price breaks the Asian high in the first hour of London and closes back inside the range, sell at the next candle open

claims.text: The stop is five pips above the breakout wick.
claims.quote: Put the stop five pips above the breakout wick

claims.text: The target is loosely the middle of the range.
claims.quote: I usually take profit somewhere around the middle of the range

claims.text: Trade it only Tuesday to Thursday.
claims.quote: I only trade it from Tuesday to Thursday because Monday ranges are too small
